input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap in the agreement is one-sided: it limits TrueLink's liability to 12 months' compensation "paid" for hosting and support, while Client's liability (including its broad indemnity in Section 12a) is entirely uncapped — the playbook walk-away scenario. There is also no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and no carve-out set beyond gross negligence/wilful misconduct (no confidentiality, data security, indemnification, fraud or IP infringement carve-outs), and no protection that Client's payment obligations are not "damages". The redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds the mutual indirect-damages exclusion, and places indemnities, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, exclude indirect damages, and carve out indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement and Client's payment obligations.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently protects only TrueLink and leaves Client's liability unlimited, so we have made it mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Client's obligation to pay fees is not subject to it; if USD 1,000,000 is unacceptable, we can fall back to a mutual 12 months' fees cap with these carve-outs retained.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE 12 MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER THIS SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING CAP.
